title: Non-cryptographic random used to generate session identifiers
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/session.py:L11 uses random.choice() from the standard random module to build session IDs; random is seeded from the system clock and is not cryptographically unpredictable, making session IDs guessable. Use secrets.choice() instead.

title: SHA-1 used for password hashing — weak against brute-force attacks
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/session.py:L15 hashes passwords with hashlib.sha1(); SHA-1 is a fast general-purpose hash without work-factor tuning, making offline brute-force attacks feasible. A purpose-built algorithm such as bcrypt, scrypt, or argon2 is required for password storage.
